data.content:
Here's the comparison of the four quotations for RFQ-2026-014 (50 business laptops):

| Vendor | Quote | Total delivered price | Delivery lead time |
|---|---|---|---|
| BrightPath Systems | BPS-7781 | **USD 35,750.00** (free shipping) | 21 calendar days |
| Orbital IT Partners | OIT-3302 | USD 36,480.00 (4% volume discount, shipping included) | 10 business days |
| Nimbus Tech Supply | NTS-0415 | USD 36,700.00 (incl. USD 300 express shipping) | **7 business days** |
| Acme Computing Ltd | Q-ACM-2209 | USD 37,550.00 (incl. USD 450 shipping) | 14 business days |

**Lowest total delivered price:** BrightPath Systems at USD 35,750.00 (free shipping on orders over USD 20,000).

**Fastest delivery:** Nimbus Tech Supply at 7 business days (stock held locally).

Note: BrightPath's 21 *calendar* days is roughly 15 business days, so it's slower than Nimbus, Orbital, and Acme.

Best price: BrightPath Systems
Fastest delivery: Nimbus Tech Supply
